reference.title: Ornadyne O1 launch (motion.so)
reference.notes: Cinematic hardware grammar: a typed question with a caret on black, archival footage in a rounded CRT bezel with a caption, HUD tracking boxes over real footage, then the product turning slowly on a dark studio floor and a quiet wordmark. Studied from what the page shows publicly; rebuilt in Moovi's own code (packages/library/src/kits/launch) with our own fonts, sounds and assets.

parts.name: Typed with a caret
parts.about: the line types at a steady rate with an accent caret that blinks on a fixed clock once it stops

parts.name: Flash cut
parts.about: a three-frame flash on the cut (paper white on light films, the accent on dark), with a hit

parts.name: CRT bezel
parts.about: the shot sits in a rounded inset frame with scanlines and a soft vignette: archival footage

parts.name: HUD target lock
parts.about: a tracking box whose corners close in on a target, then a mono label types beside it

parts.name: Soft vignette
parts.about: a soft vignette that pulls the eye to the centre (dark beats)

parts.role: the provocation that opens the film
parts.name: Typed question on black
parts.about: one question types itself in the middle of black at an uneven human pace with a thin grey caret, then the product's glowing seam wakes on the floor below

parts.role: centuries of attempts in under a second
parts.name: Archive strobe of old prints
parts.about: a dozen chipped archival prints with engraved plates flick past one or two frames each, then one print lands, turns and holds over a lowercase line

parts.role: the history of failure before the answer
parts.name: Attempts reel in a CRT bezel
parts.about: short clips of earlier tries play inside a rounded, bowed old-monitor bezel with scanlines and grain, cutting on phrases while a lowercase narrator swaps below

parts.name: Loud: waveform at dusk
parts.about: a small hovering machine bobs against a slate-to-warm dusk while a spiky white waveform across the lower third bursts on each beat and settles

parts.name: Detection box zoom track
parts.about: the shot racks into focus on a dot on the horizon, a thin glowing box snaps round it with a confidence label, then a long-lens digital zoom tracks in, softening and jittering

parts.name: Crash flash montage
parts.about: four cold black-and-white failures (a tumble with motion ghosts, an impact throwing shards, a spinning horizon, wreckage with smoke) cut with single white and black frames

parts.role: the stakes, in the operator's screen
parts.name: Ground station HUD
parts.about: a top-down aerial feed drifts under a full ground-station HUD (compass, flight timer, altitude ladder, telemetry rows from the brand's items, zoom pad) and a red quad locks onto a moving vehicle

parts.name: Defocused fly-past reveal
parts.about: in a dark studio the product passes behind the line completely out of focus while the reveal line types with a soft glow and a pause before the name

parts.name: Rim-lit profile
parts.about: the product side-on just above eye level on a dark floor, lit up from black, a thin white rim along its shoulder and a glowing accent seam, the line above

parts.role: the heroic angle, with what it does
parts.name: Low three-quarter orbit
parts.about: a low camera on the product's front three-quarter turning at 3.5 deg/s over a long soft shadow, spec callouts riding points on the object

parts.name: Head-on push
parts.about: a symmetric view along the product's short axis with a steady dolly in from 0.9x to 1.25x while the light comes up

parts.name: High three-quarter
parts.about: a high camera looking down on the product turning slowly, its top face and engraved mark catching the strip light, callouts on the object

parts.name: Plan view to brand mark
parts.about: the product seen straight down dims to a silhouette, then cross-dissolves into the brand's line-art medallion at the same size, the line arriving below

parts.role: the product section in one beat
parts.name: Hero angle suite
parts.about: three angles of the product in one dark studio, each lit up from black and ended in black, one feature named per angle with an index, the line on the last

parts.name: Quiet wordmark
parts.about: on a near-black floor the wordmark focuses in from blur, a small square mark and the tagline sit above it, an accent seam draws beneath, a slow fade

parts.name: Emblem pull-back
parts.about: a line-art medallion starts ten times too close so its strokes sweep the frame like ribbons, then pulls back turning until it sits alone as the wordmark fades

parts.name: Typed question with caret
parts.about: a line types itself at an uneven human pace, recentring as it grows, with a thin grey caret that blinks when idle and a held breath before the last character

parts.name: Glow typed reveal
parts.about: the line types at 16 characters a second with a soft bloom pass under the crisp letters and a pause before the last word (the name)

parts.role: from the question into the archive
parts.name: Scanline power-on
parts.about: two frames of white with the old title inverted through fine scanlines, then the next shot settles from a slight vertical stretch

parts.role: from the past to the real thing
parts.name: Bezel escape burst
parts.about: the shot over-exposes in a stacked radial zoom blur that bursts outward, one black frame, then the clean next shot settles from 1.05x

parts.name: Lens bloom defocus
parts.about: a one-frame exposure dip, then the shot blooms and defocuses with colour fringes, the next shot landing soft and snapping into focus

parts.name: Dip to black breath
parts.about: the picture dips to black and holds a breath of pure black before the next world fades up out of it

parts.role: the product becomes the thing it answers
parts.name: Silhouette match dissolve
parts.about: the outgoing object darkens to a silhouette, then dissolves into the next shot scaled so its entry object starts at the old object's size and place

parts.name: Invert flicker steps
parts.about: two-frame steps slam the shot to hard mono, then its negative, then the next card in negative, then settled from 1.08x

parts.name: Surveillance zoom
parts.about: a slow digital zoom into the focus point that jitters a pixel as it goes, like a long-lens feed

parts.name: Macro push turn
parts.about: a push into a screen's readouts with a slight turn and a lateral slide

parts.name: Studio dolly
parts.about: a steady, near-linear dolly in with a breath of rise, the product-shot move

parts.name: CRT monitor bezel
parts.about: an old monitor: a dark rounded casing around bowed glass with a bright rim, burnt edges, scanlines and grain, playing a clip or its stand-in

parts.role: makes found images feel like history
parts.name: Archival print plate
parts.about: an off-white print with chipped edges, a slight turn and warm foxing, carrying an engraved figure or a sepia photo and a plate number

parts.name: HUD compass rose
parts.about: a dark disc with a turning tick ring, cardinal letters, the craft glyph at the centre and a heading readout

parts.name: HUD altitude ladder
parts.about: a tall scale of ticks scrolling with the value and an accent-edged pointer box reading it

parts.name: HUD telemetry panel
parts.about: a dark glass panel with a mono title, a blinking record dot and rows of label and value sliding in, the brand's items as live readouts

parts.name: Backer eyebrow badge
parts.about: a tiny "backed by" line over a small square mark and a name in the accent, sitting quietly above a lockup

parts.name: Waveform burst
parts.about: a thin spiky white waveform across the lower third whose amplitude bursts each second and decays

parts.name: Detection box snap
parts.about: a thin glowing box with heavy corners snaps round the focus target, follows the camera's zoom and shows a counting confidence label

parts.name: Lock quad shiver
parts.about: a thick accent quad, skewed with the screen's perspective, springs onto the target and shivers with the feed

parts.name: Light-up from black
parts.about: the shot starts in black, the light comes up over 1.8 s on an ease-out and drops back over the last 0.6 s

parts.name: Cold mono grade
parts.about: the shot drained to black and white with lifted greys and grain, so failure reads as evidence

parts.name: Dusk haze grade
parts.about: a soft-light slate-to-warm gradient and a faint haze laid over the shot, the colour of watching something far away

parts.name: Slate studio sweep
parts.about: a near-black seamless with a lighter floor in the middle ground and the glow of a strip light from above

uses.role: single white and black frames between crash clips
grain inside the CRT bezel and on the mono failures
the defocused dot racks into the distant machine
macro push into the readouts and the head-on push
slow orbit on the three-quarter angles
soft blob under the hovering product
lowercase film subtitles with a soft shadow
archival footage in a rounded inset frame
